name: Meeting 7
definition: Information about the date and location(s) of a general meeting.

DateAndTime.name: Date And Time
DateAndTime.definition: Date and time at which the meeting will take place.

QuorumRequired.name: Quorum Required
QuorumRequired.definition: Indicates whether a minimum number of security representation is required to hold a meeting.

Location.name: Location
Location.definition: Location at which the meeting will take place.

QuorumQuantity.name: Quorum Quantity
QuorumQuantity.definition: Minimum quantity of securities required to hold a meeting.

URLAddress.name: URL Address
URLAddress.definition: Address for the Universal Resource Locator (URL), for example, used over the www (HTTP) service.

DateStatus1Rule.definition: If DateAndTime/DateCode is "UKWN" (Unknown), then DateStatus must not be present.
